Name: SVE Trees Recolored - For Popular Recolors
Author: Morghoula
Description:
[b][size=5][img]https://i.ibb.co/RCHH0QP/Trees.gif[/img][/size]
[color=#e8e6e3][size=2]** The other default tree replacers seen in the screenshots are from "Simple Foliage".



[/size][/color]
[size=5]Features[/size][/b]
Designed to match the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20972]Simple Foliage 1.6 Unofficial Update[/url], this mod provides recolors of the new SVE trees introduced in v1.15 for several popular recolors, including:
[list]
[*]VPR
[*]Wittily
[*]Earthy
[*]Naturally
[*]Starblue
[/list]
Once a recolor has been selected in the GMCM options menu (or set manually in the config file), this mod overrides the following files:
[list]
[*]SVE's new choppable trees
[*]SVE's new fruit and nut trees
[*]The areas of SVE's new outdoor/town tilesheets, which contain trees
[/list]
If you'd like a bit more foliage during the winter months, you can select "Winter leaves on Birch Trees" in the options ([b][color=#ff7700]NOTE: if you change this setting during winter and it doesn't work, you may have to simply toggle it off and back on again[/color][/b]).

Downloads.Description: Fixed the new fruit trees not being replaced.
